name: Chicken Adobo

name: Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni until tender.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then add milk and cheese to make a sauce.
Mix the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce and serve hot.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Cook the chicken and slice it.
Toast the bread and cut into croutons.
Toss the lettuce, chicken, croutons, and cheese with a creamy dressing.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Cook the beef with chopped onion until browned.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, chopped tomato, and cheese.

name: Beef Quesadilla
steps: Cook the beef with onion until browned.
Place beef and cheese on half a tortilla and fold.
Toast in a pan until crispy and cheese is melted.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Fry the pork until golden brown.
Sauté bell pepper and pineapple.
Add vinegar and sugar, then toss the pork in the sauce until coated.

name: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Melt butter and sauté garlic and shrimp.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice, and serve.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sauté onion and mushroom in a pot.
Add rice and gradually add water, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in cheese and serve creamy.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook chicken and vegetables in a pan.
Make a creamy sauce with milk and flour.
Pour into a dish, top with a dough crust, and bake until golden.

name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Stir-fry the beef and onion in a hot pan until cooked.
Serve with rice.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring water and chopped onion to a boil.
Stir in soy sauce.
Slowly pour in beaten eggs while stirring to create ribbons.

name: Pork Sisig
steps: Boil the pork until tender, then grill or broil until crispy.
Chop the pork into small pieces and mix with chopped onion, soy sauce, calamansi, and chili.
Serve on a sizzling plate and top with an egg.

name: Beef Kare-Kare
steps: Boil the beef until very tender, saving the broth.
Sauté onion and garlic, add the beef broth and peanut butter, and simmer until thick.
Add the beef and blanched vegetables. Serve with a side of shrimp paste.

name: Lechon Kawali
steps: Boil the pork belly with salt and pepper until tender.
Let it dry completely, then deep fry until the skin is crispy and golden.
Chop into pieces and serve with lechon sauce.

name: Bicol Express
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and pork until browned.
Add the shrimp paste, chili, and coconut milk.
Simmer until the pork is tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Laing
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and shrimp paste.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a boil.
Add the taro leaves and simmer until tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Pinakbet
steps: Sauté tomato and shrimp paste.
Add the squash and a little water, and simmer until half-cooked.
Add the eggplant, green beans, and okra. Cook until tender.

name: Bulalo
steps: Boil the beef bones in water, skimming the scum.
Add the onion and corn, and simmer for 1-2 hours until the beef is tender.
Add the cabbage at the end and season with salt and pepper.

name: Arroz Caldo
steps: Sauté ginger, garlic, and chicken in a pot.
Add the rice and water, and simmer until the rice breaks down into a porridge.
Season with salt and top with fried garlic and a boiled egg.

name: Lumpiang Shanghai
steps: Mix ground pork with minced carrot and onion.
Wrap the mixture in lumpia wrappers.
Deep fry until golden brown and crispy. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

name: Pancit Palabok
steps: Boil the noodles until soft and place on a plate.
Cook a thick sauce using shrimp paste, garlic, and water.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and top with boiled eggs and shrimp.

name: Chicken Inasal
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, calamansi, and crushed garlic.
Grill over hot coals or pan-fry in oil until cooked through.
Serve with rice and a side of soy sauce and calamansi dip.

name: Beef Mechado
steps: Marinate the beef in soy sauce and lemon juice.
Sauté garlic and onion, add the beef, and brown it.
Add the tomato sauce and water, and simmer until the beef is tender. Add potatoes and cook until soft.

name: Pork Menudo
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, then add the pork and cook until browned.
Add the tomato sauce, water, and diced potatoes and carrots.
Simmer until the pork and vegetables are tender.

name: Chicken Afritada
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and chicken.
Add the tomato sauce and water, and simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Add the potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper, and simmer until tender.

name: Beef Caldereta
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the beef and cook until browned.
Add the tomato sauce and water, and simmer until the beef is tender.
Add the potatoes, carrots, bell pepper, and cheese. Cook until vegetables are soft.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté onion and garlic, then add the ground beef until browned.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes. Toss with pasta.

name: Beef Lasagna
steps: Boil lasagna noodles until soft.
Cook beef with onion and tomato sauce.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, and cheese in a dish. Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Alfredo
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Cook sliced chicken and garlic in a pan.
Add cream and cheese, simmer until thick, and toss with pasta.

name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles in warm water until soft.
Stir-fry shrimp and eggs in a wok.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and peanuts. Toss until heated through.

name: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Cook beef strips and onion in a pan until browned.
Add mushrooms and cream, and simmer.
Serve over cooked pasta.

name: Chili con Carne
steps: Sauté onion and beef until browned.
Add tomatoes, beans, and chili powder.
Simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Serve with rice or bread.

name: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs and milk in a bowl.
Dip bread slices into the mixture.
Fry in butter until golden brown on both sides. Serve with syrup.

name: Buttermilk Waffles
steps: Mix dry ingredients, then whisk in eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Pour batter into a hot waffle iron.
Cook until golden and crisp. Serve with butter and syrup.

name: Shepherds Pie
steps: Cook beef, onion, and carrot in a pan.
Boil and mash potatoes with milk.
Layer beef mixture in a dish, top with mashed potatoes, and bake until golden.

name: Meatloaf
steps: Mix beef, onion, egg, and bread crumbs.
Shape into a loaf and place in a baking pan.
Top with tomato sauce and bake at 180°C for 45 minutes.

name: Fish and Chips
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and deep fry until golden.
Dip the fish in a batter made of flour and milk.
Deep fry the fish until crispy. Serve with the fries.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen
steps: Boil pork in water for 45 minutes to make a rich broth. Season with soy sauce.
Cook noodles in a separate pot.
Serve noodles in the broth, topped with sliced pork and a soft-boiled egg.

name: Chicken Katsu
steps: Coat chicken in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs.
Deep fry until golden brown and cooked through.
Slice and serve with rice and katsu sauce.

name: Bibimbap
steps: Stir-fry beef, carrot, and spinach separately.
Place hot rice in a bowl and arrange the toppings on top.
Top with a fried egg and serve with soy sauce.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry chopped kimchi in oil for 2 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Top with a fried egg.

name: Beef Pho
steps: Simmer beef, ginger, and onion in water for 1 hour to make broth.
Cook noodles and place in a bowl.
Top with thinly sliced raw beef and pour the hot broth over it.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
steps: Mix shredded cabbage and carrots.
Wrap the vegetables in spring roll wrappers.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Shrimp Tempura
steps: Mix flour and egg with cold water to make a batter.
Dip shrimp in batter and deep fry until crispy and golden.
Serve with a dipping sauce.

name: Miso Soup
steps: Bring water to a simmer and add chopped onion.
Add cubed tofu.
Turn off heat, dissolve miso paste into the soup, and serve.

name: Classic Cheeseburger
steps: Form beef into patties and grill or pan-fry until cooked.
Toast the buns.
Assemble with cheese, onion, and tomato.

name: Club Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread.
Cook chicken and bacon.
Layer bread, chicken, bacon, lettuce, and tomato, then top with another slice of bread.

name: BLT Sandwich
steps: Cook the bacon until crispy.
Toast the bread.
Layer bacon, lettuce, and tomato between the bread slices.

name: Tuna Melt
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise (if available) or butter.
Place tuna and cheese between two slices of bread.
Grill in a pan until the bread is golden and cheese is melted.

name: BBQ Pork Ribs
steps: Boil the pork ribs until tender.
Mix tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar, and garlic to make a BBQ sauce.
Grill the ribs while brushing with the sauce until sticky and charred.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
steps: Slow cook the pork with onion and water until it falls apart.
Shred the pork and mix with tomato sauce.
Serve the pulled pork inside the buns.

name: Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni until tender.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then add milk and cheese to make a sauce.
Mix the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce and serve hot.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Cook the chicken and slice it.
Toast the bread and cut into croutons.
Toss the lettuce, chicken, croutons, and cheese with a creamy dressing.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Cook the beef with chopped onion until browned.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, chopped tomato, and cheese.

name: Beef Quesadilla
steps: Cook the beef with onion until browned.
Place beef and cheese on half a tortilla and fold.
Toast in a pan until crispy and cheese is melted.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Fry the pork until golden brown.
Sauté bell pepper and pineapple.
Add vinegar and sugar, then toss the pork in the sauce until coated.

name: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Melt butter and sauté garlic and shrimp.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice, and serve.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sauté onion and mushroom in a pot.
Add rice and gradually add water, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in cheese and serve creamy.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook chicken and vegetables in a pan.
Make a creamy sauce with milk and flour.
Pour into a dish, top with a dough crust, and bake until golden.

name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Stir-fry the beef and onion in a hot pan until cooked.
Serve with rice.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring water and chopped onion to a boil.
Stir in soy sauce.
Slowly pour in beaten eggs while stirring to create ribbons.

name: Chicken Binakol
steps: Sauté ginger, onion, and chicken in a pot.
Pour in the coconut water and add the coconut meat.
Simmer until the chicken is tender. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Pork Hamonado
steps: Marinate the pork in soy sauce, sugar, and pineapple juice.
Sear the pork in a pot, then add the marinade and pineapple chunks.
Simmer until the pork is very tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Beef Nilaga
steps: Boil the beef in water with onion until tender.
Add the potatoes and cook until soft.
Add the cabbage and cook for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Tokwa't Baboy
steps: Boil the pork until tender, then deep fry until crispy.
Deep fry the tofu until golden and cut into cubes.
Mix the pork and tofu with soy sauce, vinegar, and chopped onions.

name: Chicken Asado
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the chicken and cook until browned.
Add soy sauce and sugar.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.

name: Pininyahang Manok
steps: Sauté onion and chicken until browned.
Add the pineapple and bell pepper.
Pour in the milk and simmer until the chicken is tender.

name: Ginataang Hipon
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the squash and green beans.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.

name: Chicken Lollipop
steps: Fashion the chicken wings into lollipops and marinate in soy sauce.
Dip in egg and coat with flour.
Deep fry until golden brown.

name: Pork Estofado
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then brown the pork.
Add tomato sauce, water, and sliced bananas (or plantains).
Simmer until pork is tender, then add potatoes and carrots.

name: Beef Asado
steps: Marinate beef in soy sauce and sugar.
Sauté onion and garlic, then add the beef and marinade.
Simmer until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Pancit Luglug
steps: Boil the noodles and set aside.
Make a sauce with shrimp paste, flour, and water.
Pour the sauce over noodles and top with shrimp and boiled eggs.

name: Chicken Sopas
steps: Boil chicken in water until cooked, then shred.
Add pasta and carrots to the broth and cook until tender.
Stir in the milk and shredded chicken. Season to taste.

name: Lomi
steps: Boil water and add the pork until cooked.
Add the thick lomi noodles and cabbage.
Crack an egg into the soup and stir gently until cooked.

name: Beef Mami
steps: Simmer beef with garlic and onion in water until tender.
Cook the noodles separately and place in a bowl.
Pour the hot beef broth and sliced beef over the noodles.

name: Pork Afritada
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and pork until browned.
Add tomato sauce and water, and simmer until pork is tender.
Add potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper. Cook until soft.

name: Chicken Pastel
steps: Cook chicken and onion in a pot with a little water.
Add sliced sausages and potatoes.
Pour in the milk and simmer until the sauce is creamy.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Sauté onion and chicken in a pan.
Add curry powder and tomato sauce, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: Roast Chicken
steps: Rub the chicken with butter, salt, and pepper. Stuff with lemon.
Place in a roasting pan with potatoes and carrots.
Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until golden and cooked through.

name: Beef Pot Roast
steps: Sear the beef in a large pot.
Add water, onion, potatoes, and carrots.
Cover and simmer for 1.5 hours until the beef falls apart.

name: Chicken Tenders
steps: Slice chicken into strips.
Dip in egg then coat with flour.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Sear chicken in a pan until golden.
Mix honey, garlic, and soy sauce. Pour over the chicken.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is sticky.

name: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Mix soy sauce, sugar, and ginger.
Pan-fry the salmon until almost cooked.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until it thickens and glazes the salmon.

name: Lemon Butter Pasta
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Melt butter and mix with lemon juice and zest.
Toss the pasta in the lemon butter and top with cheese.

name: Garlic Bread
steps: Mix softened butter with minced garlic.
Spread on the bread slices.
Toast in the oven or a pan until golden.

name: Caesar Wrap
steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Toss lettuce and chicken with Caesar dressing (or mayonnaise).
Wrap in tortillas with cheese.

name: Buffalo Wings
steps: Bake or fry the chicken wings until crispy.
Melt butter and mix with vinegar and chili (hot sauce).
Toss the cooked wings in the spicy sauce.

name: Mozzarella Sticks
steps: Cut mozzarella into sticks.
Dip in egg and coat with bread crumbs. Freeze for 10 minutes.
Deep fry until golden brown.

name: Pizza Margherita
steps: Roll out the dough.
Spread tomato sauce and top with cheese and sliced tomatoes.
Bake at 220°C for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden.

name: Cheeseburger Sliders
steps: Form small beef patties and cook in a pan.
Top with cheese and let melt.
Place in small buns with chopped onion.

name: Beef and Barley Soup
steps: Sear beef in a pot with onion.
Add water, carrots, and barley.
Simmer for 45 minutes until the beef is tender and barley is soft.

name: French Onion Soup
steps: Slowly caramelize sliced onions in butter (about 20 minutes).
Add water (or beef broth) and simmer for 15 minutes.
Top with toasted bread and cheese, then broil until melted.

name: Bruschetta
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Rub raw garlic on the toasted bread.
Top with diced tomatoes mixed with oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella cheese.
Arrange them on a plate, alternating slices.
Drizzle with oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Coat chicken in flour and pan-fry until golden.
Remove chicken. In the same pan, add lemon juice and butter.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve.

name: Sloppy Joes
steps: Cook beef and onion until browned.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon the mixture onto buns and serve.

name: Veggie Quesadilla
steps: Sauté bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms until soft.
Place vegetables and cheese on a tortilla and fold.
Toast in a pan until golden and cheese is melted.

name: Jambalaya
steps: Sauté sausage, onion, and bell pepper.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Stir in the cooked rice and season with salt and pepper.

name: Gumbo
steps: Brown the sausage with onion and bell pepper.
Add water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Baked Potato Soup
steps: Boil potatoes until soft and mash them slightly.
Fry bacon and onion, then add to the potatoes with milk.
Simmer until thick, then top with cheese.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Boil broccoli and onion in water until tender.
Blend slightly, then stir in milk and cheese.
Heat until the cheese is melted and the soup is creamy.

name: Beef Chili
steps: Brown the beef with chopped onion.
Add tomatoes, beans, and chili powder.
Simmer for 25 minutes until thick.

name: Chicken Potstickers
steps: Mix ground chicken, cabbage, and soy sauce.
Wrap in dumpling wrappers.
Pan-fry until the bottoms are crispy, then add a little water and cover to steam.

name: Pork Gyoza
steps: Mix ground pork, cabbage, and soy sauce.
Wrap in dumpling wrappers.
Pan-fry until crispy, then steam with a splash of water.

name: Vegetable Lo Mein
steps: Boil noodles until soft.
Stir-fry carrots, bell pepper, and cabbage in a wok.
Add noodles and soy sauce, and toss until well mixed.

name: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Stir-fry beef and garlic until browned.
Add broccoli and a splash of water, cover to steam for 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and toss until coated.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
steps: Fry chicken until golden.
Sauté bell pepper and pineapple.
Add vinegar and sugar, then toss the chicken in the sauce.

name: Orange Chicken
steps: Coat chicken in flour and fry until crispy.
Make a sauce with orange juice, sugar, and vinegar.
Toss the chicken in the sauce until coated.

name: Sesame Chicken
steps: Coat chicken in flour and fry until crispy.
Mix soy sauce and sugar, and simmer until thick.
Toss chicken in the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Mongolian Beef
steps: Slice beef thinly and fry in a hot pan.
Add sliced onion.
Mix soy sauce and sugar, pour over beef, and cook until sticky.

name: Fried Ice Cream
steps: Scoop ice cream into balls and freeze until hard.
Dip in egg and coat with bread crumbs. Freeze again.
Deep fry quickly until golden and serve immediately.

name: Pork BBQ Skewers
steps: Slice pork thinly and marinate in soy sauce, sugar, lemon, and garlic.
Thread the pork onto skewers.
Grill over hot coals or pan-fry until cooked and slightly charred.

name: Kwek-Kwek (Orange Quail Eggs)
steps: Boil the quail eggs, peel them, and set aside.
Mix flour, water, and orange food coloring to make a batter.
Coat the eggs in batter and deep fry until crispy.

name: Arroz a la Cubana
steps: Sauté ground beef with garlic and onion until cooked.
Fry the sliced potatoes and bananas separately.
Serve the beef, potatoes, bananas, and a fried egg over rice.

name: Pancit Malabon
steps: Boil thick rice noodles and set aside.
Sauté shrimp, cabbage, and shrimp paste. Add a little water to make a sauce.
Toss the noodles in the sauce and top with sliced boiled eggs.

name: Pancit Molo
steps: Mix ground pork with garlic and onion, and wrap in dumpling wrappers.
Boil the dumplings in water to make a savory broth.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

name: La Paz Batchoy
steps: Simmer pork in water with garlic to make a rich broth.
Cook noodles separately and place in a bowl.
Pour the broth and sliced pork over the noodles, topping with a raw egg and crispy pork rinds.

name: Pata Tim
steps: Boil pork leg until tender, then set aside.
In a pot, mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and garlic to make a sweet-savory sauce.
Simmer the pork in the sauce until it becomes sticky and glazed.

name: Paksiw na Pata
steps: Place the pork, vinegar, soy sauce, and garlic in a pot.
Add the sliced banana (or banana blossoms) and a little water.
Simmer until the pork is tender and the sauce is reduced.

name: Halabos na Hipon
steps: Melt butter in a pan and sauté garlic.
Add the shrimp and water.
Cover and simmer until the shrimp turns pink and the water evaporates.

name: Inihaw na Pusit
steps: Marinate the squid in soy sauce, lemon, and sugar for 10 minutes.
Grill over hot coals for 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice and serve with a vinegar dip.

name: Kinilaw na Tuna
steps: Cut fresh tuna into cubes.
Soak the tuna in vinegar for 5 minutes to cure it.
Drain and mix with chopped onion, ginger, and chili. Serve chilled.

name: Igado
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the pork and liver.
Add vinegar and soy sauce, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and cook until tender.

name: Dinakdakan
steps: Boil pork until tender, then grill until slightly charred. Chop into small pieces.
Mix the pork with chopped onion, chili, vinegar, and lemon juice.
Serve with a creamy mayonnaise-based sauce if desired.

name: Poqui-poqui
steps: Grill the eggplants until soft, then peel and mash them.
Sauté onion and tomato, then add the mashed eggplant.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until cooked.

name: Ilocos Bagnet
steps: Boil pork belly in salted water until tender.
Air dry, then deep fry until the skin is completely crispy and blistered.
Chop and serve with chopped tomatoes.

name: Pork Embutido
steps: Mix ground pork, chopped sausage, carrots, eggs, and bread crumbs.
Shape into a log and wrap tightly in foil.
Steam for 45 minutes, then let it cool before slicing.

name: Everlasting (Marikina Meatloaf)
steps: Mix ground pork with chopped carrots, bell peppers, and tomato sauce.
Place in a loaf pan and top with cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until cooked through.

name: Valenciana
steps: Sauté chicken, sausage, bell pepper, and carrots.
Add the cooked rice and mix well.
Cook for another 5 minutes to let the flavors blend.

name: Callos
steps: Boil beef tripe (or beef chunks) until very tender.
Sauté sausage, carrots, and bell pepper.
Add the beef, tomato sauce, and broth. Simmer until thick.

name: Lengua Estofada
steps: Boil ox tongue (or beef) until tender and slice.
Sauté onion and add the meat, tomato sauce, and potatoes.
Simmer until potatoes are soft, then top with cheese.

name: Bangus Sisig
steps: Fry or grill the bangus (milkfish) until crispy, then flake the meat.
Mix the fish with chopped onion, soy sauce, lemon, and chili.
Serve sizzling on a hot plate.

name: Tuna Sisig
steps: Drain the tuna and mix with chopped onion, chili, and lemon.
Cook in a hot pan for 3 minutes.
Crack an egg over the mixture, stir until cooked, and serve.

name: Chicken Sisig
steps: Boil and shred the chicken, then fry until slightly crispy.
Mix with chopped onion, soy sauce, lemon, and chili.
Serve hot on a sizzling plate.

name: Sizzling Gambas
steps: Melt butter in a sizzling plate or pan.
Sauté garlic, onion, and chili.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and coated in the garlic butter sauce.

name: Cheesy Baked Tahong
steps: Clean the mussels and boil until the shells open.
Mix minced garlic with softened butter and top each mussel.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 200°C until the cheese melts.

name: Hawaiian Pizza
steps: Roll out the pizza dough and spread tomato sauce.
Top with cheese, ham, and pineapple chunks.
Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
steps: Roll out the dough and spread tomato sauce.
Top with cheese and pepperoni slices.
Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes until crispy.

name: Beef Shawarma Rice
steps: Marinate and pan-fry the beef with curry powder until cooked.
Serve the beef over rice.
Top with chopped cucumber and tomato.

name: Pork Katsu Curry
steps: Coat pork in bread crumbs and fry until crispy. Slice.
Boil potatoes and carrots in water with curry powder to make a curry sauce.
Serve the sliced pork katsu over rice with the curry sauce.

name: Chicken Karaage
steps: Marinate chicken in soy sauce and garlic.
Coat in flour.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Oyakodon
steps: Simmer chicken and sliced onion in soy sauce and a little water.
Pour beaten eggs over the chicken and cover until the eggs are just set.
Slide the mixture over a bowl of hot rice.

name: Katsudon
steps: Bread and fry the pork until crispy, then slice.
Simmer onion and sliced pork in a pan with soy sauce and water.
Pour beaten egg over the top, cover to cook, and serve over rice.

name: Gyudon
steps: Simmer thinly sliced beef and onions in soy sauce and sugar.
Cook until the beef is tender and the sauce is slightly thick.
Serve over a bowl of warm rice.

name: Japchae
steps: Boil sweet potato noodles and set aside.
Stir-fry carrots and spinach.
Mix the noodles and vegetables with soy sauce and sugar.

name: Tteokbokki
steps: Boil water and add the rice cakes and sliced onion.
Add soy sauce, sugar, and chili paste (or chopped chili).
Simmer until the sauce thickens and the rice cakes are soft.

name: Buldak (Spicy Fire Chicken)
steps: Stir-fry chicken with garlic, soy sauce, and lots of chili until cooked.
Transfer to a pan and top with melted cheese.
Serve very hot with rice.

name: Beef Wellington
steps: Sear the beef fillet until browned.
Wrap the beef in ham and a mushroom mixture.
Wrap in pastry dough, brush with egg, and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.

name: Ratatouille
steps: Slice all vegetables thinly.
Sauté onion and bell pepper, then spread them on the bottom of a baking dish.
Arrange the sliced vegetables on top, drizzle with oil, and bake for 30 minutes.

name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Press dough into a pie pan to make the crust.
Sprinkle cooked bacon and cheese over the crust.
Whisk eggs and milk, pour into the crust, and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.

name: Beef Bourguignon
steps: Sear the beef in a pot, then add carrots, onion, and mushrooms.
Pour in water (traditionally red wine) and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour until the beef is very tender.

name: Coq au Vin
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in a pot.
Add onions, carrots, and mushrooms.
Pour in water (or wine) and simmer for 40 minutes until the chicken is tender.

name: Chicken and Waffles
steps: Coat chicken in flour and deep fry until crispy.
Mix flour, eggs, and milk to make waffle batter. Cook in a waffle iron.
Serve the crispy chicken on top of the waffles.

name: Biscuits and Gravy
steps: Make biscuits by mixing flour, milk, and butter, and bake until golden.
Fry the sausage and crumble it into a pan with milk and flour to make a white gravy.
Pour the sausage gravy over the warm biscuits.

name: Philly Cheesesteak
steps: Slice the beef very thinly and stir-fry with onions and bell peppers.
Melt cheese over the meat mixture in the pan.
Scoop the cheesy meat into a sliced bread roll.

name: Reuben Sandwich
steps: Layer sliced corned beef, cheese, and sauerkraut (or cabbage) between bread slices.
Butter the outside of the bread.
Grill in a pan until the bread is toasted and cheese is melted.

name: Gyro Sandwich
steps: Cook the beef with Mediterranean spices and slice it.
Warm the pita bread and spread with a cucumber-yogurt sauce (or cream).
Fill with the meat, chopped onions, and tomatoes.

name: Falafel Wrap
steps: Mash chickpeas with flour and spices to form small patties.
Pan-fry the patties in oil until crispy.
Wrap the falafel in tortillas with sliced cucumber and a creamy sauce.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop the tomatoes, cucumber, and onion into large chunks.
Toss with olive oil and salt.
Top with a block of feta cheese and serve.

name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Sauté onions and chicken with curry powder until browned.
Add the cream and simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Layer the chicken and cooked rice in a pot, cover, and steam for 10 minutes.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch and blend the spinach into a puree.
Sauté onions and curry powder, then add the spinach puree and cream.
Add cubes of firm tofu (or paneer cheese) and simmer for 10 minutes.

name: Pochero (Beef Stew with Saba)
steps: Boil the beef until tender, saving the broth.
Sauté onion and garlic, add the beef and tomato sauce.
Add the broth and saba bananas. Simmer until the bananas are soft, then add the cabbage.

name: Humba (Visayan Sweet Pork)
steps: Sear the pork in a pot until browned.
Add vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and pineapple chunks.
Simmer for 45 minutes until the pork is very tender and the sauce is thick.

name: Kansi (Ilonggo Sour Beef Soup)
steps: Boil the beef in water until very tender.
Add the tamarind mix to create a sour broth.
Add the saba banana and radish, and simmer until tender. Season with salt.

name: Sinanglay (Fish in Taro Leaves)
steps: Wrap the fish fillets in taro leaves.
Place in a pan with coconut milk, onion, and chili.
Simmer gently for 15-20 minutes until the fish is cooked and the leaves are tender.

name: Kinunot (Shredded Fish in Coconut)
steps: Boil the fish until cooked, then shred the meat.
Sauté onion and chili, then add the coconut milk.
Add the shredded fish and spinach. Simmer until the sauce thickens.

name: Tiyula Itum (Black Beef Stew)
steps: Sear the beef with garlic, onion, and ginger.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Cook until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick and dark.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in a pan.
Add onions, bell peppers, and mushrooms, and sauté.
Pour in the tomato sauce and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked.

name: Pork Tacos al Pastor
steps: Marinate thinly sliced pork in chili and spices.
Sear the pork in a hot pan until cooked and slightly charred.
Serve on warm tortillas with chopped pineapple and onion.

name: Laksa
steps: Sauté curry powder in a pot, then add coconut milk and water.
Bring to a boil, then add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Pour the soup over cooked noodles and serve.

name: Beef Rendang
steps: Blend onion, garlic, and chili into a paste.
Sear the beef with the paste, then pour in the coconut milk.
Simmer for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce is completely reduced and dark.

name: Tom Yum Goong
steps: Boil water with ginger and chili.
Add mushrooms and shrimp, and cook until the shrimp are pink.
Season with lemon juice and salt for a spicy-sour flavor.

name: Pad See Ew
steps: Stir-fry chicken in a hot wok.
Add flat rice noodles and soy sauce.
Push noodles aside, scramble the eggs, then mix with sugar and serve.

name: Banh Mi
steps: Pickle the shredded carrots in vinegar and sugar.
Cook the pork and slice it.
Stuff the bread with pork, pickled carrots, and sliced cucumber.

name: Paella
steps: Sauté bell peppers and shrimp in a wide pan.
Add rice and curry powder (as a substitute for saffron).
Pour in the water and simmer without stirring until the rice is cooked.

name: Chicken Mole Poblano
steps: Boil the chicken until cooked and shred it.
Blend tomato sauce, chili powder, peanut butter, and garlic to make a mole sauce.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce for 15 minutes.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in a pan.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer to make a thick sauce.
Make small wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them. Cover and cook until eggs are set.

name: Eggs Benedict
steps: Poach the eggs in simmering water.
Toast the bread and top with ham.
Place the poached egg on top and drizzle with a lemon-butter sauce.

name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread on the toast and top with a fried egg.

name: Chilaquiles
steps: Fry the tortilla chips until crispy.
Simmer the tomato sauce and pour over the chips.
Top with fried eggs and cheese.

name: Crab Cakes
steps: Mix crab meat, bread crumbs, and egg to form patties.
Pan-fry in oil until golden brown on both sides.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Lobster Roll
steps: Cook the lobster meat and chop it into chunks.
Mix with cream and butter.
Stuff the mixture into a toasted bread roll.

name: Lobster Bisque
steps: Sauté onion in butter, then add the lobster and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and heat through.

name: Fried Green Tomatoes
steps: Slice the tomatoes and dip in egg, then flour.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Season with salt and serve.

name: Cornbread
steps: Mix flour, cornmeal (or blended corn), milk, and egg.
Pour into a buttered baking pan.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Pulled Chicken Sandwich
steps: Boil and shred the chicken.
Mix tomato sauce, sugar, and the chicken in a pan and simmer.
Serve on buns topped with shredded cabbage.

name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Pan-fry the pork chops until cooked, then set aside.
In the same pan, sauté mushrooms in butter and sprinkle with flour.
Stir in the milk to make a gravy, then return the pork chops to the pan.

name: Chicken Fried Steak
steps: Pound the beef flat. Dip in egg and coat with flour.
Pan-fry in oil until golden brown.
Make a white gravy using milk and flour, and pour over the steak.

name: Chicken and Dumplings
steps: Boil chicken with onion in water to make a broth.
Mix flour and milk into a dough and drop spoonfuls into the boiling broth.
Simmer until the dumplings are cooked and the broth thickens.

name: Maja Blanca
steps: Mix all ingredients in a pot.
Stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture thickens.
Pour into a mold and let it cool and set before serving.

name: Sapin-sapin
steps: Mix rice flour, coconut milk, and sugar into a batter.
Divide the batter into layers and color them separately if desired.
Steam each layer one by one until fully cooked and set.

name: Buko Pandan
steps: Mix the coconut meat, cream, milk, and sugar in a bowl.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least an hour.
Serve cold as a dessert.

name: Cassava Cake
steps: Grate the cassava and mix with coconut milk, sugar, and eggs.
Pour into a baking dish.
Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes until set and golden.

name: Ube Halaya
steps: Boil and mash the ube (purple yam).
In a pot, mix the mashed ube, coconut milk, sugar, and butter.
Stir constantly over low heat until thick and smooth.

name: Pichi-pichi
steps: Mix grated cassava with sugar and water to form small balls.
Steam for 20 minutes until translucent.
Roll in grated coconut before serving.

name: Buko Pie
steps: Make a pie crust using flour and butter, and press into a pan.
Fill with a mixture of coconut meat, milk, and sugar.
Cover with another layer of crust and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.

name: Ensaymada
steps: Make a soft dough with flour, milk, eggs, and sugar.
Shape into spirals and bake until golden.
Top with butter and grated cheese.

name: Pan de Sal
steps: Mix flour, milk, sugar, and butter into a dough.
Shape into small rolls and coat with bread crumbs.
Bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes until golden.

name: Beef Salpicao
steps: Sear the beef cubes in a hot pan with butter.
Add lots of minced garlic and soy sauce.
Cook until the beef is tender, then finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Adobong Dilaw (Yellow Adobo)
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, ginger, and turmeric.
Add the chicken and cook until browned.
Pour in vinegar and soy sauce, and simmer until the chicken is tender.

name: Asadong Manok (Chicken Asado)
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the chicken and cook until browned.
Add soy sauce and sugar.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.

name: Sinigang na Corned Beef
steps: Boil water with onion and radish.
Add the tamarind mix.
Add the corned beef and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Goto (Beef Tripe Porridge)
steps: Simmer beef tripe (or beef chunks) with ginger and garlic until tender.
Add the rice and water, and simmer until the rice breaks down into a porridge.
Season with salt and top with fried garlic.

name: Pinaputok na Tilapia
steps: Stuff the tilapia with chopped tomato, onion, and ginger.
Wrap in banana leaves or foil.
Grill or bake for 20 minutes, then serve with lemon.

name: Inihaw na Bangus
steps: Clean the bangus and stuff with chopped tomato and onion.
Grill over hot coals for 10 minutes per side.
Serve with a vinegar dipping sauce.

name: Daing na Bangus
steps: Marinate the butterflied bangus in vinegar and garlic for 10 minutes.
Pan-fry in hot oil until crispy and golden.
Serve with garlic fried rice and eggs.

name: Tortang Giniling
steps: Sauté onion, potato, and ground pork until cooked.
Beat the eggs and mix with the cooked meat.
Fry the mixture in oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: Ginisang Togue
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then add the tofu and carrots.
Add the bean sprouts and soy sauce.
Stir-fry for 3 minutes until the sprouts are slightly tender.

name: Ginisang Pechay
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ground pork.
Add the pechay stalks and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the leaves and soy sauce, and cook until wilted.

name: Chopsuey
steps: Sauté garlic and onion.
Add all the vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and a little water, and cook until tender-crisp.

name: Sotanghon Guisado
steps: Soak the glass noodles in water until soft.
Stir-fry chicken, carrots, and cabbage.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, and toss until well mixed.

name: Scrambled Egg
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl and add milk, salt, and pepper.
Whisk the mixture until well combined.
Melt the butter in a pan over low-medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and gently stir using a spatula.
Cook until the eggs are soft and fully set, then serve.

name: Bistek Tagalog
steps: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, calamansi juice, minced garlic, and pepper for 20 minutes.
Pan-fry onion rings in oil until lightly browned, then set aside.
Sear the beef in batches, add the marinade and a splash of water, and simmer until tender. Top with onion rings.

name: Ginisang Monggo
steps: Boil mung beans in water until soft and bursting.
In a separate pot, sauté garlic, onion, tomato, and pork until browned.
Add the boiled mung beans with their broth, season with fish sauce, and stir in spinach before serving.

name: Ginisang Ampalaya
steps: Slice the bitter melon thinly, rub with salt, and rinse to reduce bitterness.
Sauté garlic, onion, and tomato in hot oil.
Add the bitter melon and stir-fry 4 minutes, then pour in beaten eggs and toss until set.

name: Tortang Talong
steps: Grill or broil the eggplants until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft, then peel off the skin.
Flatten the eggplants with a fork and dip into seasoned beaten eggs.
Pan-fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Serve with ketchup or soy sauce.

name: Ginataang Kalabasa at Sitaw
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger in a pot.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer, then add the squash.
Once the squash is nearly tender, add the string beans and shrimp and cook 5 minutes more.

name: Pork Binagoongan
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and tomato, then add the pork and brown well.
Add vinegar and water, then simmer until the pork is tender.
Stir in the shrimp paste and fried eggplant slices, cooking 5 minutes more.

name: Beef Pares
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger, then brown the beef cubes.
Add soy sauce, sugar, star anise, and water, then simmer until the beef is fork-tender.
Serve hot with garlic fried rice and a side of clear soup.

name: Paksiw na Bangus
steps: Arrange sliced bangus, eggplant, ginger, garlic, and chili in a pot.
Pour in vinegar and water, season with salt and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes until the fish is cooked and the broth is flavorful.

name: Escabeche
steps: Season and fry the fish in oil until crispy, then place on a serving platter.
Sauté onion, carrot, and bell pepper, then add vinegar, sugar, ketchup, and a splash of water.
Simmer until the sweet-and-sour sauce thickens, then pour over the fried fish.

name: Sinigang na Bangus sa Miso
steps: Sauté onion, tomato, and miso paste in a pot.
Pour in water and bring to a boil, then add the tamarind mix and bangus.
Simmer 10 minutes, add mustard greens, and cook 2 minutes before serving.

name: Adobong Sitaw
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and pork strips until browned.
Add soy sauce and vinegar and simmer 5 minutes.
Add cut string beans and cook until tender-crisp.

name: Ginisang Sayote
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, tomato, and pork strips in hot oil.
Add sliced chayote and a splash of water, then cover and simmer until tender.
Season with fish sauce and pepper and serve with rice.

name: Ginisang Upo
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, tomato, and ground pork until cooked.
Add sliced bottle gourd and a little water, simmering until translucent and tender.
Season with fish sauce and pepper.

name: Misua with Patola
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and pork meatballs or ground pork in a pot.
Add water and bring to a boil, then add sliced sponge gourd.
Stir in the misua noodles and fish sauce, cooking 2 minutes until soft.

name: Sardines with Misua
steps: Sauté garlic and onion in oil, then add the canned sardines with sauce.
Pour in water and bring to a boil.
Add the misua noodles, cook 2 minutes, and serve hot.

name: Corned Beef Guisado
steps: Dice and pan-fry the potatoes in oil until golden, then set aside.
Sauté garlic and onion, then add the corned beef and cook 5 minutes.
Toss the fried potatoes back in, season with pepper, and serve with rice.

name: Tocilog
steps: Pan-fry pork tocino with a splash of water until the water evaporates and the meat caramelizes.
Fry garlic fried rice and sunny side up eggs in oil.
Serve together with a side of spiced vinegar.

name: Bangsilog
steps: Fry marinated milkfish in oil until crispy and golden.
Prepare garlic fried rice and fry two eggs.
Serve the fish, garlic rice, and eggs together with vinegar dip.

name: Spamsilog
steps: Slice the luncheon meat and pan-fry until crisp on both sides.
Fry the eggs and stir-fry rice with minced garlic.
Plate together and serve hot.

name: Hotsilog
steps: Score and pan-fry the hotdogs in oil until lightly browned.
Fry eggs and prepare garlic fried rice.
Serve hot with banana ketchup.

name: Chicksilog
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper and fry until golden and crispy.
Stir-fry cold rice with minced garlic and fry two eggs.
Serve everything hot on a plate.

name: Champorado
steps: Boil glutinous rice in water, stirring often, until soft and thick.
Whisk in cocoa powder and sugar until fully dissolved.
Serve warm drizzled with milk.

name: Ginataang Bilo-Bilo
steps: Mix glutinous rice flour with a little water and roll into small balls.
Simmer coconut milk, water, and cubed sweet potato until half-cooked.
Add the rice balls, sliced saba bananas, and sugar, cooking until the balls float and the sauce thickens.

name: Banana Cue
steps: Heat oil in a deep pan and fry peeled saba bananas for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle brown sugar over the bananas and stir until the sugar melts and coats them.
Drain on a tray and thread onto bamboo skewers.

name: Camote Cue
steps: Peel and slice sweet potatoes into thick pieces and fry in hot oil until tender.
Add brown sugar to the pan and toss until caramelized and coated.
Remove, drain, and skewer while warm.

name: Maruya (Banana Fritters)
steps: Whisk flour, milk, egg, and sugar into a smooth batter.
Slice saba bananas lengthwise, fan them out, and dip in batter.
Deep fry until golden brown and crisp, then dust with sugar.

name: Ukoy (Shrimp Fritters)
steps: Whisk flour, egg, water, salt, and pepper into a light batter.
Fold in bean sprouts and small shrimp.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until crisp and golden. Serve with vinegar.

name: Lumpiang Togue
steps: Sauté cubed tofu, shredded carrot, and bean sprouts with soy sauce for 3 minutes; let cool.
Wrap spoonfuls of filling tightly in lumpia wrappers.
Deep fry until crisp and golden. Serve with spiced vinegar.

name: Pancit Bihon Guisado
steps: Soak rice noodles in water until pliable, then drain.
Sauté garlic, chicken, carrot, and cabbage in a wok.
Add water and soy sauce, then toss in the noodles until the liquid is absorbed.

name: Sizzling Tofu
steps: Cube and deep fry the tofu until golden and crisp.
Melt butter in a hot skillet and sauté onion and chili.
Toss in the crispy tofu, mayonnaise, and soy sauce, stirring quickly until coated.

name: Crispy Kangkong
steps: Wash and dry kangkong leaves thoroughly.
Whisk flour, cornstarch, salt, and cold water into a thin batter.
Dip leaves in batter and deep fry until crisp. Serve with garlic mayo dip.

name: Biko (Sweet Sticky Rice Cake)
steps: Cook glutinous rice with 1 can of coconut milk and a splash of water until tender.
Simmer the remaining coconut milk with brown sugar and salt until thick and caramel-like.
Fold the rice into the sweet coconut sauce, cook until sticky, and press into a tray.

name: Palitaw
steps: Mix glutinous rice flour and water into a smooth dough and shape into flat ovals.
Drop into boiling water and remove once they float to the surface.
Coat in grated coconut, sugar, and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Puto Cheese
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, milk, and egg into a smooth batter.
Pour into greased small molds and top each with a slice of cheese.
Steam for 12 to 15 minutes until puffy and cooked through.

name: Ensaladang Talong
steps: Grill or broil eggplants until soft, peel, and chop coarsely.
Mix with diced tomato and onion.
Dress with vinegar, salt, and pepper and serve chilled.

name: Ensaladang Mangga
steps: Peel and julienne the green mangoes.
Toss with diced tomato and sliced red onion.
Serve with shrimp paste on the side or mixed in.

name: Salted Egg and Tomato Salad
steps: Peel and dice the salted eggs.
Chop tomatoes and slice onion thinly.
Toss gently together with a splash of vinegar and serve.

name: Crispy Pata
steps: Boil pork leg with garlic, bay leaves, and salt until tender, then drain and chill until dry.
Deep fry in hot oil until the skin is deeply golden and blistered.
Chop and serve with soy-vinegar dipping sauce.

name: Inihaw na Liempo
steps: Marinate pork belly slices in soy sauce, calamansi, garlic, ketchup, and pepper for 30 minutes.
Grill over hot coals for 6 to 8 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Slice and serve with spiced vinegar.

name: Ginataang Manok
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, ginger, and chicken until lightly browned.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer until chicken is tender.
Add sliced green papaya and chili, cooking until papaya is soft.

name: Ginataang Tilapia
steps: Simmer coconut milk with ginger, onion, and chili for 5 minutes.
Add cleaned tilapia and cook gently for 12 minutes.
Add pechay leaves, season with salt, and cook 2 minutes more.

name: Dinengdeng
steps: Bring water and fish paste to a boil in a pot.
Add squash and simmer 5 minutes until half-cooked.
Add eggplant, string beans, and okra, cooking until all vegetables are tender.

name: Sinampalukang Manok
steps: Sauté ginger, onion, tomato, and chicken in a pot.
Add water and simmer until the chicken is tender.
Stir in tamarind mix and kangkong, cook 2 minutes, and serve hot.

name: Pesang Isda
steps: Boil water with ginger, onion, and potato until the potato is nearly soft.
Add the fish and simmer 10 minutes until cooked.
Add pechay, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

name: Suam na Mais
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and shrimp in a pot.
Add grated corn kernels and water, simmering 12 minutes until thickened.
Season with fish sauce and stir in spinach before serving.

name: Calamares
steps: Slice squid into rings and season with salt and pepper.
Dip in beaten egg and dredge in flour mixed with cornstarch.
Deep fry 2 minutes until golden and crisp. Serve with spiced vinegar.

name: Camaron Rebosado
steps: Peel and devein shrimp, leaving tails on, and season with salt.
Whisk flour, egg, and cold water into a smooth batter.
Dip shrimp in batter and deep fry until puffed and golden.

name: Pork Steak (Bistek Baboy)
steps: Marinate pork chops in soy sauce, calamansi, garlic, and pepper.
Pan-fry onion rings and set aside, then sear the pork chops.
Add the marinade and water, simmering until tender. Top with onions.

name: Mango Float
steps: Whip chilled cream with condensed milk until smooth.
Layer graham crackers, cream mixture, and sliced ripe mangoes in a dish.
Repeat layers and chill overnight before slicing.

name: Buko Salad
steps: Drain the fruit cocktail well and combine with shredded young coconut.
Fold in chilled cream, condensed milk, and diced cheese.
Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

name: Garlic Butter Crabs
steps: Clean and halve the crabs.
Melt butter in a wok and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add crabs, toss to coat, cover, and cook 10 minutes until shells turn bright red. Finish with lemon.

name: Sweet Chili Shrimp
steps: Sauté garlic in oil and add the shrimp, cooking 2 minutes.
Stir in sweet chili sauce and ketchup.
Toss until glossy and shrimp are cooked through. Serve with rice.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Crisp chopped bacon in a pan, then remove from heat.
Toss hot pasta with bacon, then quickly mix in beaten eggs, grated cheese, pepper, and a splash of pasta water until creamy.

name: Pesto Pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente and reserve a little pasta water.
Toss warm pasta with pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Top with grated cheese and serve.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Gently toast sliced garlic and chili flakes in olive oil until fragrant.
Toss pasta in the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water and chopped parsley.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
steps: Boil penne until al dente.
Sauté garlic and chili flakes in olive oil, then add tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss pasta in the spicy sauce and serve.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Sauté sliced zucchini, bell pepper, carrot, and garlic in olive oil until tender-crisp.
Toss with pasta, a splash of pasta water, and grated cheese.

name: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Coat chicken breasts in egg and bread crumbs, then pan-fry until golden.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with tomato sauce and cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Slice eggplants, dip in egg and bread crumbs, and fry until golden.
Layer eggplant, tomato sauce, and cheese in a baking dish.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until bubbly.

name: Baked Ziti
steps: Boil pasta until slightly underdone.
Mix pasta with sautéed onion, garlic, tomato sauce, and cream.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with cheese, and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.

name: Minestrone Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and zucchini in oil for 5 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, beans, and water, simmering 15 minutes.
Add small pasta and cook until tender. Season and serve.

name: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
steps: Toast bread slices until crisp.
Toss diced tomatoes with minced garlic, chopped basil, olive oil, and salt.
Spoon onto toasted bread and serve immediately.

name: Creamy Tomato Gnocchi
steps: Boil gnocchi until they float, about 2 minutes.
Simmer garlic, tomato sauce, and cream in a skillet for 5 minutes.
Toss gnocchi into the sauce and top with cheese.

name: Tiramisu
steps: Whip mascarpone, cream, and sugar until thick and fluffy.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in cooled coffee and layer in a dish.
Spread cream over layers, dust with cocoa powder, and chill 4 hours.

name: Panna Cotta
steps: Bloom gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes.
Heat cream, sugar, and vanilla until hot, then whisk in the gelatin until dissolved.
Pour into ramekins and chill 4 hours until set.

name: Chicken Teriyaki
steps: Pan-fry chicken thighs in oil until golden and cooked through.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, honey, and grated ginger, then pour into the pan.
Simmer until the glaze thickens and coats the chicken. Serve with rice.

name: Beef Teriyaki
steps: Sear sliced beef and onion in hot oil.
Pour in soy sauce, sugar, and grated ginger.
Simmer 3 minutes until glossy and serve over rice.

name: Yakisoba
steps: Stir-fry pork, cabbage, and carrot in hot oil until tender.
Add cooked yakisoba noodles, worcestershire sauce, and soy sauce.
Toss over high heat for 3 minutes and serve.

name: Udon Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer water with soy sauce and cubed tofu for 5 minutes.
Add udon noodles and cook 3 minutes.
Top with sliced scallion and a soft-boiled egg.

name: Okonomiyaki
steps: Mix flour, egg, water, and shredded cabbage into a thick batter.
Spread into a pancake in an oiled pan, top with bacon strips, and cook 5 minutes per side.
Drizzle with mayonnaise and savory sauce before serving.

name: Tamagoyaki
steps: Whisk eggs with soy sauce and sugar.
Pour a thin layer into an oiled pan, roll it up once set, and repeat with remaining egg.
Slice into bite-size rolls and serve.

name: Agedashi Tofu
steps: Cube firm tofu, coat in cornstarch, and deep fry until crisp.
Simmer water and soy sauce for 2 minutes to make a light broth.
Place tofu in a bowl, pour broth around it, and top with scallion.

name: Kimchi Jjigae
steps: Sauté pork, kimchi, and onion in a pot for 5 minutes.
Add water and gochujang, then simmer 15 minutes.
Add sliced tofu, simmer 5 minutes more, and serve bubbling hot with rice.

name: Sundubu Jjigae
steps: Sauté onion and gochujang in a pot, then add water and bring to a boil.
Add shrimp and large spoonfuls of soft tofu, simmering 6 minutes.
Crack an egg on top, cover 2 minutes, and serve hot.

name: Korean Fried Chicken
steps: Coat chicken in cornstarch and double-fry in hot oil until extra crispy.
Simmer gochujang, honey, and soy sauce in a pan until sticky.
Toss crispy chicken in the glaze and serve immediately.

name: Samgyeopsal
steps: Grill thick pork belly slices with garlic cloves until browned and crisp.
Mix sesame oil with salt for dipping.
Wrap grilled pork and garlic in lettuce leaves and enjoy.

name: Jajangmyeon
steps: Sauté diced pork, onion, and zucchini in oil.
Add black bean paste and stir-fry 2 minutes, then add water and cornstarch slurry until thick.
Pour the glossy black bean sauce over boiled noodles.

name: Kimbap
steps: Season warm rice with sesame oil and salt.
Spread rice on seaweed sheets and layer with strips of egg, ham, carrot, and cucumber.
Roll tightly, brush with sesame oil, and slice into bite-size rounds.

name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Sauté ground pork, garlic, ginger, and chili bean paste in a wok.
Add water, soy sauce, and cubed tofu, simmering gently for 8 minutes.
Thicken with a splash of cornstarch water and serve over rice.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Stir-fry diced chicken in hot oil until browned.
Add bell pepper, dried chilies, and peanuts, cooking 3 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar, tossing until glossy.

name: Cashew Chicken
steps: Stir-fry diced chicken in oil until cooked through.
Add bell pepper, onion, and cashews, tossing 3 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and oyster sauce and serve with rice.

name: Pepper Steak
steps: Sear thinly sliced beef in hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry sliced bell peppers and onion until tender-crisp.
Return beef to the pan with soy sauce and plenty of cracked black pepper.

name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
steps: Poach chicken in water with ginger and garlic until tender, reserving the broth.
Cook rice using the chicken broth instead of plain water.
Serve sliced chicken over fragrant rice with cucumber slices.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Bring water, mushrooms, tofu, soy sauce, vinegar, and pepper to a simmer.
Thicken lightly with cornstarch mixed in water.
Slowly drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring and serve hot.

name: Wonton Soup
steps: Fill dumpling wrappers with seasoned ground pork and fold into wontons.
Simmer water with ginger and soy sauce, then drop in the wontons until they float.
Add bok choy, cook 2 minutes, and serve hot.

name: Nasi Goreng
steps: Sauté onion, chili, and chicken in hot oil.
Add cold rice and sweet soy sauce, stir-frying 4 minutes.
Top with a crispy fried egg and serve.

name: Mie Goreng
steps: Boil noodles and drain.
Stir-fry shrimp, cabbage, and scrambled egg in oil.
Toss in noodles, sweet soy sauce, and soy sauce until evenly coated.

name: Chicken Satay
steps: Marinate chicken strips in curry powder and soy sauce, thread onto skewers, and grill.
Simmer peanut butter, coconut milk, and sugar into a creamy dipping sauce.
Serve hot skewers with peanut sauce.

name: Thai Green Curry Chicken
steps: Fry green curry paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add chicken, remaining coconut milk, eggplant, and bell pepper.
Simmer 15 minutes until tender, season with fish sauce, and serve with rice.

name: Thai Red Curry Beef
steps: Sauté red curry paste in oil for 1 minute.
Add sliced beef and coconut milk, simmering until beef is tender.
Add bell pepper, bamboo shoots, and fish sauce, cooking 5 minutes more.

name: Tom Kha Gai
steps: Simmer coconut milk, water, and sliced ginger for 5 minutes.
Add chicken and mushrooms and cook until tender.
Remove from heat and stir in fish sauce and fresh lime juice.

name: Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls
steps: Cook shrimp and rice noodles and let cool.
Dip rice paper in warm water until soft.
Fill with lettuce, noodles, cucumber, carrot, and shrimp, then roll tightly.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, and chicken in butter until browned.
Stir in curry powder and tomato sauce, simmering 15 minutes.
Swirl in cream and extra butter, then serve with rice or naan.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in oil until golden.
Add curry powder and tomato sauce, cooking 3 minutes.
Stir in chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes until rich and thick.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Boil lentils with turmeric and water until soft and creamy.
In a small pan, sizzle cumin, garlic, onion, and tomato in butter.
Pour the spiced tempering over the lentils and serve hot.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Sauté cumin, onion, and tomato in oil.
Add cubed potatoes, cauliflower florets, and turmeric.
Cover and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender.

name: Hummus
steps: Drain chickpeas, reserving a little liquid.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, and salt until silky smooth.
Drizzle with extra olive oil and serve with pita bread.

name: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak bulgur in hot water until tender, then drain well.
Finely chop parsley, tomato, and cucumber.
Toss everything with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.

name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
steps: Marinate chicken with cumin, paprika, salt, and oil, then pan-fry and slice.
Warm pita bread and spread with seasoned yogurt.
Fill with chicken, cucumber, and tomato, then wrap tightly.

name: Beef Kofta Kebabs
steps: Mix ground beef with grated onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, parsley, and salt.
Shape onto skewers.
Grill or pan-sear 4 minutes per side until cooked through.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Cook shredded chicken with onion and chili powder.
Roll filling into tortillas and arrange in a baking dish.
Cover with tomato sauce and cheese, baking at 190°C for 20 minutes.

name: Beef Burrito
steps: Brown beef with salt, pepper, and chili powder.
Warm large tortillas and layer with rice, beans, beef, diced tomato, and cheese.
Fold sides in and roll tightly.

name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken, bell peppers, and onion into strips.
Sear in hot oil with chili powder and salt until charred and cooked through.
Serve sizzling with warm tortillas.

name: Guacamole
steps: Mash ripe avocados in a bowl.
Fold in diced tomato, minced onion, cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

name: Pico de Gallo
steps: Finely dice tomatoes, onion, and chili.
Toss with chopped cilantro, fresh lime juice, and salt.
Let rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Warm tortillas and spread with heated beans.
Simmer tomato sauce and fry eggs sunny side up.
Place eggs on tortillas, spoon sauce over, and sprinkle with cheese.

name: Peruvian Fish Ceviche
steps: Cut fresh fish into cubes and toss with fresh lime juice and salt; chill 15 minutes.
Add thinly sliced red onion, chopped chili, and cilantro.
Serve cold with boiled sweet potato slices.

name: Loaded Nachos
steps: Spread tortilla chips on a baking tray and top with beans and cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 8 minutes until cheese melts.
Top with diced tomato, avocado, and sour cream.

name: Classic Grilled Cheese
steps: Butter the outside of each bread slice.
Place cheese between slices and cook in a skillet over medium-low heat.
Flip once golden and cook until cheese is completely melted.

name: Clam Chowder
steps: Fry chopped bacon, then sauté onion in the drippings and stir in flour.
Add diced potatoes, clam juice, and water, simmering until potatoes are soft.
Stir in clams and cream, heating gently without boiling.

name: Gazpacho
steps: Chop tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, and garlic.
Blend with olive oil, vinegar, and salt until smooth.
Chill thoroughly before serving.

name: Butternut Squash Soup
steps: Sauté onion, squash, and diced apple in butter for 5 minutes.
Add water and simmer 25 minutes until very soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in cream, and season with salt.

name: Beef Goulash
steps: Sauté onions in oil until soft, then stir in paprika and beef cubes.
Add tomato sauce, bell peppers, and water.
Simmer covered for 1 hour until beef is tender.

name: Pork Schnitzel
steps: Pound pork cutlets thin and season with salt and pepper.
Dredge in flour, dip in egg, and coat with bread crumbs.
Pan-fry in oil until crisp and golden. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Croque Monsieur
steps: Make a quick white sauce by cooking butter, flour, and milk until thick.
Assemble ham and cheese sandwiches, spread sauce and extra cheese on top.
Broil 4 minutes until golden and bubbly.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Halve and seed bell peppers.
Cook beef and onion, then mix with rice and half the tomato sauce.
Stuff peppers, top with remaining sauce and cheese, and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes.

name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel, cube, and boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender.
Drain well and mash with butter and warm milk.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

name: Coleslaw
steps: Combine shredded cabbage and grated carrot in a bowl.
Whisk mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, and salt together.
Toss well and chill 15 minutes before serving.

name: Garlic Parmesan Fries
steps: Cut potatoes into fries and toss with oil and salt.
Bake at 220°C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Toss hot fries with minced garlic, grated cheese, and parsley.

name: Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Cut sweet potatoes into thin strips.
Toss with oil, paprika, and salt.
Bake at 220°C for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.

name: Onion Rings
steps: Slice onions into thick rings.
Dip in flour, then milk, then coat in bread crumbs.
Deep fry until golden brown and crispy.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar, then beat in egg and vanilla.
Mix in flour and fold in chocolate chips.
Drop spoonfuls onto a baking sheet and bake at 180°C for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Melt butter and whisk in sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Fold in cocoa powder and flour until just combined.
Bake in a lined pan at 180°C for 22 minutes.

name: Banana Bread
steps: Mash ripe bananas and mix with melted butter, sugar, and egg.

Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake at 175°C for 45 minutes.

name: Apple Crumble
steps: Toss sliced apples with cinnamon and place in a baking dish.

Bake at 190°C for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Classic Crepes
steps: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, and sugar into a thin batter.
Swirl a small ladleful into a lightly buttered pan.
Cook 1 minute per side and serve with fruit or syrup.

name: Churros
steps: Boil water and butter, stir in flour until a dough forms, then beat in egg.

name: Classic Cheesecake
steps: Mix crushed graham crackers with melted butter and press into a springform pan.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, eggs, and vanilla until smooth and pour over crust.
Bake at 160°C for 45 minutes, then chill 4 hours.

steps: Crisp chopped bacon in a pot and sauté diced onion.
Add cubed potatoes, corn, and water; simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in cream, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in oil for 4 minutes.
Add chicken, potatoes, and water; simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

name: Beef Vegetable Stew
steps: Brown beef cubes in oil, then sauté onion.
Add tomato sauce, water, carrots, and potatoes.
Simmer covered for 1 hour until beef is fork-tender.

name: Sweet Potato Coconut Soup
steps: Sauté onion and ginger, then add cubed sweet potatoes and water.
Simmer 20 minutes until soft, then blend until smooth.
Stir in coconut milk, season with salt, and serve.

name: Spinach Lentil Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, and carrot for 4 minutes.
Add lentils and water; simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted, season, and serve.

name: Spicy Shrimp Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer water with ginger, chili, and fish sauce for 5 minutes.
Add noodles and shrimp, cooking until shrimp turn pink.
Finish with fresh lime juice and serve hot.

name: Roasted Tomato Garlic Soup
steps: Roast halved tomatoes, onion, and garlic with olive oil at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Blend roasted vegetables with water until smooth.
Simmer with cream, season with salt, and serve.

name: Creamy Zucchini Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, and sliced zucchini for 5 minutes.
Add potato and water, simmering 15 minutes until soft.
Blend smooth, stir in cream, and season.

name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion, bell pepper, garlic, and cumin in oil.
Add black beans and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Mash partially for thickness and serve with lime.

name: Creamy Chicken Rice Soup
steps: Sauté onion and carrot, then add chicken and water; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in cooked rice and cream, heating gently.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Miso Ramen Soup
steps: Sauté ground pork, add water, and bring to a simmer.
Whisk in miso paste off the heat, then add cooked noodles.
Top with sweet corn and soft-boiled eggs.

name: Tofu Vegetable Soup
steps: Bring water, soy sauce, carrot, and mushrooms to a simmer.
Add cubed tofu and bok choy, cooking 4 minutes.
Season to taste and serve hot.

name: Pork and Cabbage Stew
steps: Brown pork and onion in a pot.
Add tomato sauce, water, and potatoes; simmer 30 minutes.
Add cabbage and cook 10 minutes until tender.

name: Fisherman Seafood Chowder
steps: Sauté onion, then simmer potatoes in water until tender.
Add fish, shrimp, and milk, cooking gently 8 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

name: Chickpea Tomato Stew
steps: Sauté onion and cumin in oil.
Add chickpeas, tomato sauce, and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve.

name: Split Pea and Ham Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and diced ham in a pot.
Add peas and water, simmering 35 minutes until thick.
Season with pepper and serve hot.

name: Garlic Egg Drop Noodle Soup
steps: Sauté garlic in a pot, add water and soy sauce, and bring to a boil.
Cook noodles until tender, then drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring.
Serve immediately.

name: Sausage Lentil Stew
steps: Brown sliced sausage with onion and carrot.
Add lentils, tomato sauce, and water.
Simmer 30 minutes until lentils are tender and stew is thick.

name: Ginger Pork Meatball Soup
steps: Form seasoned ground pork into small meatballs.
Simmer water with ginger, garlic, and fish sauce, then drop in meatballs for 12 minutes.
Add pechay, cook 2 minutes, and serve.

name: Creamy Broccoli Potato Soup
steps: Simmer onion, cubed potatoes, and broccoli in water until tender.
Blend until smooth and stir in milk.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

name: Cucumber Avocado Salad
steps: Dice cucumber and avocado into bite-size chunks.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
Toss gently with cilantro and serve.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Rinse and drain chickpeas.
Combine with diced tomato, cucumber, and parsley.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.

name: Grilled Salmon Salad
steps: Pan-sear or grill salmon fillets until flaky.

Top with salmon and dress with lemon and olive oil.

name: Mango Chicken Salad
steps: Cook and slice chicken breast.
Toss lettuce, diced mango, and cucumber in a bowl.
Top with chicken and drizzle with lime dressing.

name: Quinoa Veggie Bowl
steps: Cook quinoa in water for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Arrange quinoa in bowls with chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, and avocado.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.

name: Watermelon Feta Salad
steps: Cube chilled watermelon and place in a bowl.
Scatter crumbled cheese and torn mint leaves over top.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil.

name: Tuna Corn Salad
steps: Drain tuna and corn well.
Mix with diced cucumber, mayonnaise, and lemon juice.
Season with pepper and chill before serving.

name: Potato Bacon Salad
steps: Boil cubed potatoes and eggs until cooked, then cool.
Crisp and crumble bacon.
Toss potatoes, chopped eggs, bacon, scallion, and mayonnaise together.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato Salad
steps: Roast cubed sweet potatoes with oil at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Toss warm sweet potatoes with spinach, cheese, and walnuts.
Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar.

name: Asian Sesame Chicken Salad
steps: Cook and shred chicken.
Toss cabbage, grated carrot, and chicken together.
Dress with soy sauce, sesame oil, and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Black Bean Corn Salad

name: Eggplant Tomato Salad
steps: Roast or pan-fry diced eggplant until golden.

Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Shrimp Mango Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp until pink and let cool slightly.

Top with shrimp and squeeze fresh lime juice over everything.

name: Tofu Sesame Salad
steps: Pan-fry cubed tofu until crisp on all sides.
Arrange lettuce, cucumber, and carrot in a bowl.

name: Broccoli Bacon Salad

name: Beet and Orange Salad

Dip into beaten egg and milk.

steps: Whisk batter ingredients and gently fold in blueberries.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron until crisp and golden.
Serve warm with butter and honey.

steps: Blend oats, bananas, eggs, milk, and cinnamon until smooth.
Cook small pancakes on a buttered skillet until golden on both sides.

name: Chocolate Chip Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, egg, milk, and melted butter into a batter.
Fold in chocolate chips and cook on a buttered pan until golden.
Serve warm.

name: Savory Scallion Pancakes
steps: Mix flour and hot water into a dough, roll thin, brush with oil, sprinkle chopped scallions, and roll up.
Coil into a spiral and flatten into a disc.
Pan-fry in oil until flaky and golden on both sides.

name: Potato Pancakes (Latkes)
steps: Grate potatoes and onion, then squeeze out excess liquid thoroughly.
Mix with egg, flour, and salt.
Fry spoonfuls in hot oil until crisp and golden on both sides.

name: Zucchini Fritters
steps: Grate zucchini and squeeze dry.

name: Corn Fritters

name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Asparagus
steps: Trim asparagus and toss with olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Roast at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Top with grated cheese and serve.

name: Honey Glazed Carrots
steps: Slice carrots and simmer in a little water with butter until tender.
Drizzle with honey and cook until glossy.
Season with salt and serve.

name: Steamed Broccoli with Oyster Sauce
steps: Steam broccoli florets for 4 minutes until bright green.
Sauté minced garlic in oil and stir in oyster sauce.
Drizzle warm sauce over broccoli.

name: Buttered Garlic Corn
steps: Melt butter in a skillet and sauté garlic for 1 minute.
Add corn kernels and toss 4 minutes until sweet and hot.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Creamed Spinach
steps: Wilt spinach in butter with garlic.
Pour in cream and simmer until thick.
Stir in cheese, season, and serve.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Cut sweet potatoes into wedges and toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 210°C for 25 minutes, flipping once.
Serve crisp and hot.

name: Baked Garlic Potato Wedges
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges and toss with oil, garlic, paprika, and salt.
Bake at 210°C for 30 minutes until crisp.
Serve hot.

name: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
steps: Boil baby potatoes until fork-tender, then smash flat on a baking sheet.
Brush with olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Roast at 220°C for 25 minutes until deeply crispy.

name: Sauteed Garlic Green Beans with Almonds
steps: Blanch green beans 3 minutes and drain.
Toast sliced almonds and garlic in butter.
Toss green beans in the almond butter and season.

name: Garlic Butter Mushrooms
steps: Melt butter in a hot skillet and sear mushrooms until golden.
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.
Toss with chopped parsley and salt.

name: Spinach Cheese Dip
steps: Sauté chopped spinach and garlic until wilted.
Mix with cream cheese and shredded cheese in a baking dish.
Bake at 190°C for 15 minutes until bubbly.

name: Baba Ganoush
steps: Roast whole eggplants until collapsed and smoky, then scoop out the flesh.
Mash or blend with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, and salt.
Serve with warm pita.

name: Tzatziki Dip
steps: Grate cucumber and squeeze out all excess water.
Mix with thick yogurt, minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
Chill 15 minutes before serving.

name: Fresh Tomato Salsa
steps: Pulse tomatoes, onion, chili, garlic, cilantro, and lime juice in a blender.
Season with salt.
Serve chilled with chips.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Whisk dry ingredients in a microwave-safe mug.
Stir in milk and oil until smooth.
Microwave on high for 60 to 75 seconds until risen and set.

name: Vanilla Mug Cake
steps: Melt butter in a mug and stir in sugar, milk, vanilla, and flour.
Mix until smooth with no lumps.
Microwave 60 seconds and let cool 1 minute.

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a tall glass.
Layer with berries, toasted oats, and a drizzle of honey.
Repeat layers and serve immediately.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Steam or cook glutinous rice until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt, mixing most of it into the hot rice.
Serve with sliced ripe mango and extra coconut sauce.

name: Baked Cinnamon Apples
steps: Core apples and place in a baking dish.
Fill centers with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and oats.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until tender.

name: Banana Ice Cream (Nice Cream)
steps: Slice and freeze ripe bananas until solid.
Blend frozen bananas with milk and vanilla until thick and creamy.
Serve immediately like soft-serve.

name: Strawberry Shortcake Cups
steps: Macerate sliced strawberries with 1 tbsp sugar.
Whip cream with remaining sugar until soft peaks form.
Layer cake, strawberries, and whipped cream in glasses.

name: Peanut Butter Energy Balls
steps: Mix oats, peanut butter, honey, and chocolate chips in a bowl.
Chill 10 minutes, then roll into bite-size balls.
Store refrigerated.

name: Grilled Pineapple with Cinnamon
steps: Slice pineapple into rings and brush with melted butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon.
Grill 3 minutes per side until caramelized.
Serve warm.

name: Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
steps: Wash and dry strawberries completely.
Melt chocolate chips with oil until smooth.
Dip strawberries in chocolate and chill until firm.

name: Lemon Bars
steps: Press flour, butter, and 1/4 cup sugar into a lined pan and bake 15 minutes at 175°C.
Whisk eggs, remaining sugar, lemon juice, and 2 tbsp flour; pour over crust.
Bake 20 minutes more, chill, and slice into squares.

name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: Cream butter and brown sugar, then beat in egg.
Stir in flour, oats, and raisins.
Drop spoonfuls onto a baking sheet and bake at 180°C for 12 minutes.

name: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Whisk dry ingredients, then stir in milk, egg, and oil until just combined.
Fold in blueberries and divide into muffin cups.
Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Banana Muffins
steps: Mash bananas and mix with melted butter, sugar, and egg.
Fold in flour and baking powder.
Divide into muffin tins and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.

name: Chocolate Pudding
steps: Whisk sugar, cocoa powder, cornstarch, and milk in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbling.
Remove from heat, stir in vanilla, and chill.

name: Caramelized Bananas
steps: Melt butter in a skillet and stir in brown sugar and cinnamon.
Add sliced bananas and cook 2 minutes per side until golden and syrupy.
Serve warm over oatmeal or ice cream.
